title: AviList: The Global Avian Checklist, v2025b

release.versionBoundary: AviList states that v2025b retains the same 11,131 species concepts and core scientific names as v2025 while correcting ancillary fields and selected errata. Later annual releases require a new pinned import and concept-level diff.

acquisition.recovery: Download the exact official extended workbook URL and verify its byte count and SHA-256 before running the import. The workbook is not copied into the repository.

license.label: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.attribution: AviList Core Team. 2026. AviList: The Global Avian Checklist, v2025b. https://doi.org/10.2173/avilist.v2025b

workbookAudit.stableIdentifierDefinition: The official metadata defines AvibaseID as a unique alphanumeric stable taxonomic-concept identifier independent of nomenclature.

colInput.strictPredicate: rank=species AND status=accepted AND descendant of the exact pinned Aves or Crocodylia root

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field only when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse whitespace and trim.
Fold only the explicit Genus (Subgenus) species representation to Genus species.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation, genus, specific epithet and all remaining tokens.
matchingContract.accepted: The normalized COL Aves name equals exactly one AviList species Scientific_name.
matchingContract.officialCurrentNameRedirect: Only when there is no current-name match, the normalized COL Aves name equals exactly one official AviList Protonym and the four-digit publication year extracted from the COL authorship exactly equals the year in the AviList Authority field; that row's Scientific_name is retained as the official current name.
matchingContract.ambiguous: The permitted exact current-name or official-protonym evidence points to more than one AviList species concept, or an exact protonym has a missing/conflicting authorship year and therefore cannot exclude homonymy.
matchingContract.unmatched: No permitted exact current-name or official-protonym evidence resolves the COL Aves record.
matchingContract.nonApplicable: The 27 accepted Crocodylia species share the package but are outside AviList's avian scope and are not counted as AviList unmatched records.
matchingContract.forbidden: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered, gender-ending, genus-substitution, author-name approximation, common-name, external-checklist or higher-rank inference is permitted. Decision-summary prose is not parsed into redirects.

distributionBoundary.excludedFields: Bibliographic text, decision summaries, ranges, IUCN categories, BirdLife links, Cornell species codes, Birds of the World links, type localities, original-description titles and URLs are not copied into the crosswalk.
distributionBoundary.evidenceBoundary: AviList linkage is release-pinned nomenclatural and taxonomic-concept evidence. It is not proof that COL and AviList apply identical species concepts, and it supplies no fossil, ecology, morphology, distribution, phylogeny, ancestry, complete-history or expert-review dossier.

limitations: The crocodylomorphs-birds package count of 11,071 consists of 11,044 Aves plus 27 Crocodylia; 11,071 must not be described as an Aves count.
Exact current-name or protonym agreement is not a species-concept equivalence assertion. Many-to-one mappings, if present, remain visible in the import counts and are never used to merge COL records.
Unmatched and ambiguous COL Aves rows and upstream-only AviList species remain explicit rather than being forced through fuzzy matching.
AvibaseID identifies an AviList taxonomic concept, not a nomenclatural-name record or a phylogenetic node.
